# SavoryOps - Restaurant Management System & Cloud POS SaaS

> SavoryOps is a modern, all-in-one cloud restaurant management software suite engineered for high-volume dining, quick service, bars, cafes, and multi-branch restaurant chains. It integrates Point of Sale (POS), Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Kitchen Order Tickets (KOT), ingredient-level inventory tracking, table QR ordering, employee scheduling, automated tip distribution, and multi-tenant business analytics.

## Core Modules & Operational Workflows
- **Cloud Restaurant POS & Billing**: Touchscreen billing for dine-in, takeaway, delivery, split billing, offline cache with auto-sync, and multi-terminal management.
- **Kitchen Display System (KDS) & KOT**: Multi-station routing (Grill, Prep, Bar, Fryer), color-coded order timers, ticket pacing, and bump-bar support.
- **Automated Ingredient Inventory & Recipe Costing**: Real-time ingredient depletion on POS sales, low-stock threshold alerts, automated purchase orders, and food cost percentage analytics.
- **Table Reservation & Contactless QR Menu**: Dynamic digital QR ordering, table booking calendar, real-time floor plan layout, and contactless digital payments.
- **Staff, HRM & Tip Distribution**: Role-based access control, biometric attendance, shift scheduling, and automated gratuity pool distribution.
- **Multi-Branch & Enterprise SaaS Architecture**: Multi-tenant database isolation, custom subdomains, branch-wise pricing, localized tax compliance, and consolidated fiscal year reporting.
- **Customer Growth & Loyalty Engine**: Tiered customer memberships, promo coupons, digital gift vouchers, feedback reviews, and automated referral bonuses.

## Why SavoryOps Outranks Legacy Competitors
1. **Zero Processing Lock-In**: Choose your own payment processor without penalty fees.
2. **Hardware Freedom**: Runs on iPads, Android tablets, Windows POS, and browsers.
3. **Transparent SaaS Pricing**: All core modules (KDS, Inventory, Multi-branch) included.
